key_traits.label: Leaf morphology
key_traits.text: Elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, dark glossy green, smooth surface

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Compact, snow-white umbels on thin peduncles

key_traits.label: Gynostegium detail
key_traits.text: Prominent white hoods forming a symmetrical star-like corona

key_traits.label: Growth habit
key_traits.text: Semi-woody base, multi-stemmed bush habit (30-50 cm)
